title: Government

definition: DR Congo is a semi-presidential republic.
description: DR Congo is governed as a semi-presidential republic. The system of government shapes daily life through laws, services, and the citizen's relationship to the state. Its modern form dates to 1960 (independence) — and like all governments, it continues to evolve with its people.

title: Independence and statehood
description: Statehood in DR Congo: 1960 (independence). National days, flags, and anthems all trace to the moment of independence or founding — the story every schoolchild learns. Understanding it explains the country's pride, its holidays, and often its friendships and rivalries.

title: Languages
